name: client-delivery-toolkit
description: Tools for presenting to clients. First skill: Readout Script, which turns the slides you're presenting into a talking track in your own voice (key message, talking points, full script, transitions) plus prep notes with likely client questions. Output is a Word doc. Requires the deck; M365, Otter/Granola, Slack and Airtable connectors are optional. Logs each run (your email, tool, project code) to Newry's usage log.
